usedFor: fuse ai builds prospect lists with “Create Prospect List” and “Add Contacts to List”, then “Enrich List” fills in details.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Prospect List” in fuse ai
bestTemplate.why: The action creates an empty prospect list, so an event elsewhere can set up a place for new contacts.

watchOut: “Add Contacts to List” needs contact IDs, so use “Resolve Contact ID” first when you only have a LinkedIn URL.
